name: journal
description: Keep a private daily and weekly work journal with owner-confirmed status changes.

interface.shortDescription: Daily capture and weekly progress across AI tools
interface.longDescription: Journal is a private bullet-journal companion for daily monitoring, owner-confirmed completion, a reusable Monday-to-Sunday board, weekly close, and month, quarter, and year review. It stores concise work state and source references rather than raw email or document bodies. Project-specific durable outcomes can be reflected into the relevant Corpus project without turning Corpus into an activity log.
capabilities: Owner-confirmed completion, hold, cancel, and resume
Immutable weekly close with correction records
